# Constants
mass_per_atom = 24.305  # amu
num_atoms = 250

# Box dimensions
xlo, xhi = -0.20725450677309176, 16.06736950678843
ylo, yhi = -0.17948770062361508, 13.914752700623339
zlo, zhi = -0.3359174591405871, 26.041942459140746

# Calculate volume in cubic angstroms
volume = (xhi - xlo) * (yhi - ylo) * (zhi - zlo)

# Convert volume to cubic centimeters (1 angstrom^3 = 1e-24 cm^3)
volume_cm3 = volume * 1e-24

# Calculate total mass in grams (1 amu = 1.66053906660e-24 g)
total_mass_g = num_atoms * mass_per_atom * 1.66053906660e-24

# Calculate density in g/cm^3
density = total_mass_g / volume_cm3

# Print the density
print(f"Density: {density:.5f} g/cm^3")

# Python script to calculate density

# Constants
amu_to_grams = 1.66053906660e-24  # grams
angstrom_to_cm = 1e-8  # cm

# Box dimensions
xlo, xhi = -0.28611736709743774, 16.14623236711261
ylo, yhi = -0.2477849535255725, 13.983049953525665
zlo, zhi = -0.46373813755727156, 26.16976313755687
xy = -8.21617745729798

# Number of atoms and mass
num_atoms = 250
mass_per_atom_amu = 24.305

# Calculate volume in Å³
volume_angstrom3 = ((xhi - xlo) * (yhi - ylo) * (zhi - zlo)) - (xy * (yhi - ylo) * (zhi - zlo))

# Convert volume to cm³
volume_cm3 = volume_angstrom3 * angstrom_to_cm**3

# Calculate total mass in grams
mass_grams = num_atoms * mass_per_atom_amu * amu_to_grams

# Calculate density in g/cm³
density = mass_grams / volume_cm3

# Print the density
print(f"{density:.2f}")
